tagline: Understand the night. Follow the evidence.
empty_title: Start with the latest sleep incident
empty_body: Collect a read-only snapshot from this PC or import a diagnostic bundle. Windows may not record a definite wake source.
privacy: Local history · Read-only collection · No background monitoring
error: The action could not be completed. Your existing data is preserved.
import_hint: Choose a diagnostic JSON bundle or UTF-8 Windows event XML.
update_idle: Updates are checked from the official GitHub repository.
up_to_date: This version is up to date.
update_error: Update check failed. The repository or release may be unavailable, or GitHub may be unreachable. Try again later.
installing: Restarting to install the verified update…
install_error: Update was not installed. Keep using this version and retry. A recovery copy is retained if replacement began.
clear_body: This removes saved diagnostic captures from this app. Settings and original imported files are kept.
storage: Data stays in this Windows account. Exports replace process, device and task names with private labels. Collection is manual and does not request that Windows stay awake.
incomplete: Evidence is incomplete or inconsistent. Interpret this explanation cautiously.
direct: Windows reported the following wake source. This identifies what Windows recorded, not the intent behind the wake.
conflict: The records contain conflicting sources, timestamps or record identities. A single cause cannot be established.
unknown_source: A wake was recorded, but there is no usable directly reported source. Nearby activity alone does not establish a cause.
timer_nearby: A previously recorded timer was due near this wake. The timing is plausible evidence, not proof that the timer caused it.
blockers: At capture time, an application, service or driver held a request that may delay automatic sleep. This does not explain a past incident or prove that manual sleep would fail.
no_blockers: No system, away-mode or execution blocker was identified in this snapshot. Display and performance requests are explained below. Other reasons for staying awake may still exist.
unconfirmed: Windows recorded a sleep-entry event without a matching resume in this capture. This does not prove that sleep failed.
restart_boundary: This record marks a startup, shutdown or unexpected restart. Sleep and wake evidence is not paired across this boundary.
clock_changed: Windows recorded a clock correction. UTC timestamps and record order are retained; intervals are not inferred across the correction.
standby_transition: Windows recorded a Modern Standby transition. It is shown separately from a traditional sleep/resume pair; the event alone does not identify a wake cause.
remedy_direct: Review the named device or timer in Windows. If the wake was unwanted, check its purpose before manually changing its wake settings.
remedy_timer: Compare the timer's purpose and scheduled time with the incident. Collect soon after another wake to look for a directly reported source.
remedy_requests: Finish or pause the named activity, then collect again. Do not disable a driver or service solely because it has a request.
remedy_unknown: Collect soon after the next incident. Windows may omit a source, and some evidence requires permissions this app will not request automatically.
remedy_boundary: Review records on each side separately. A restart, missing log or clock correction can interrupt an otherwise complete timeline.
locale: Report language or format not interpreted
snapshot_context: Current reports describe their capture time. Last-wake reports have no reliable incident timestamp; armed devices show capability, not cause.
display_help: Display: asks Windows to keep the screen on; it is not by itself a system-sleep blocker.
system_help: System: asks Windows to keep the computer running during an activity; automatic sleep may be delayed.
away_help: Away mode: asks for quiet continued work instead of normal sleep on supported systems.
execution_help: Execution: asks that the process continue running; effect depends on power state and policy.
perf_help: Performance boost: requests performance; it does not by itself prove a sleep blocker.
lock_help: Active lock screen: requests lock-screen activity; it does not by itself prove a sleep blocker.
none_help: This observation is a device or timer report, not a power request.
event_limited: Event log evidence may be unavailable, limited or inconsistent.
motion_help: Transitions are brief; reduced motion makes selection changes immediate.
history_empty: No retained evidence matches this filter.
close_busy: Collection or file work is running. Wait for it to finish before closing.
update_restart: The application will restart after download and verification. Local history and settings are preserved.
no_events: No matching power events were included in this capture.
